segments.text: For as many as are of the workes of the Lawe, are vnder the curse, for it is written: Cursed is euery man that continueth not in all things, which are written in the booke of the Lawe to doe them. Likewise then as by the offence of one the fault came on all men to condemnation: so by the iustifying of one, the benefit abounded toward all men to the iustification of life.
